 Job Description
 About the project
 The project treats laboratory software in applications that cover instrument communication, data archiving, device-event processing, forecasting and configuration interfaces.
The environment combines .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.8, Angular and Razor Pages, SQLite, RabbitMQ and containerized services.
 Responsibilities
Develop maintainable C#/.NET services, REST APIs and web applications. 
Implement instrument communication, message processing, data archiving and scheduled background workflows. 
Develop user interfaces using Angular/TypeScript and ASP.NET Core Razor Pages. 
Implement data access using SQLite and Entity Framework Core, and asynchronous messaging with RabbitMQ. 
Support containerized deployment, automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. 
Contribute to AI/LLM integrations, agent workflows, technical design and continuous improvement. 
 Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core and REST APIs. 
Solid experience with Angular and TypeScript. 
Experience with SQL databases and Entity Framework Core. 
Practical knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including containerized application deployment, configuration and troubleshooting. 
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and AI agents, including API/tool integration, agent workflows and prompt-based interactions. 
Experience with automated testing, Git and CI/CD, preferably Azure DevOps. 
Ability to work independently in an Agile environment, understand existing architectures and troubleshoot complex issues. 
Professional-level English. 
 Additional Information
 Nice to Have
Experience with Razor Pages, JavaScript and jQuery. 
Knowledge of RabbitMQ, event-driven systems and Quartz.NET. 
Experience with .NET Framework 4.8, Windows services, TCP/IP sockets and asynchronous programming. 
Knowledge of HL7 or experience in medical/laboratory software. 
Familiarity with MediatR, FluentValidation, Refit and Polly. 
Experience modernizing legacy .NET applications or migrating MongoDB data to SQLite. 
Familiarity with Cake, SonarQube and SBOM generation. 
 Project Benefits
Work on software supporting laboratory diagnostics
A varied technical environment spanning modern .NET services and established applications.
